rows.name: Hållbar utveckling och globala perspektiv 1 för förskollärare

notes: HT26 education plan contains two specialisations. The programme-level credit distribution is common, while detailed study paths differ by specialisation.
The official plan states that 30 hp at advanced level are placed in the final semester; 15 hp are the mandatory LÖFA61 course and 15 hp are elective advanced-level courses.
